wholePhysicalScope: The original 1919 Sanborn sheet, registered from South Scott Avenue, fixes the approximately 38 by 71 m site, including the front porch and wing depth. The public-domain Qualla postcard fixes the Scott Avenue profile.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the stepped hotel and arcade. Nearer levels add recessed openings, frieze ornament, storefronts and tile coping.
limitations: The model represents the original hotel after the 1917 addition, visually dated to approximately 1937. It is available through the historical viewing date. The original hotel was demolished in the 1970s.
Map registration uses modern street control and estimates of the historic curb-to-centerline distances. The original hotel terrain is represented by unmodified present-day public elevation data.

The north and west facades follow the archive postcard. Rear elevations, precise floor heights, concealed roofs and arcade ornament are reconstructed approximately. The project covers the exterior, including the porch voids.
